data.title: Invoice for window glass repair (Rechnung Glasreparatur)
data.case_title: Invoice from Glaserei Beispielscheibe for window glass repair
data.summary: Glaserei Beispielscheibe billed Johanna Beispielacker €396.27 (invoice GS-26-1185, dated 20 November 2026) for replacing a damaged living-room window pane, due without deduction within 14 days of the invoice date.
data.explanation: This is an invoice from a glazier for repair work already carried out on your window. Pay the full amount of €396.27 to the IBAN shown by the deadline displayed in the app (14 days from the invoice date). If you don't pay in time, the glazier could send reminders or charge late-payment interest. The letter also mentions a direct debit for a separate, different contract (GK-8859-772) that will be collected automatically on 8 December 2026 — check that you recognise this contract and that the debit matches your own records.

data.tax_note: Craftsman services for home repairs (Handwerkerleistungen) such as this glass replacement can often be partly deducted from German income tax under §35a EStG; keep this invoice and proof of bank transfer for your tax return.
warnings: The invoice unexpectedly mentions an unrelated separate contract (GK-8859-772) with an automatic direct debit on 08.12.2026; verify this contract exists and that the debit amount matches your own records, since this is unusual information to include on a glass-repair invoice.
